$meta.comment: Canonical Figma <-> code mapping (ADR-0010). Human-readable view: Architecture.md §3.1. Every entry's code file must carry `// figma: node-id=<nodeId>` in its header. Components are added here in the same PR that creates them (Phase 2+); nodeId values are looked up in Figma dev mode or via MCP at build time.
$meta.status: pre-Phase-2: paths reserved, nodeId filled in when each component is built

Atom/Button.notes: CVA variant=filled|outline|white|transparent|destructive (Figma 'Distructive'); Hover/Selected are CSS states. 'Selected' was renamed from 'Active' in Figma 2026-07-20 (ticket #42, mis-naming corrected upstream) — re-fetched node confirms every style's State enum is now Default/Hover/Selected, same fills/text as before the rename, no pixel change. Modelled via `aria-pressed:` (not `active:` — CSS :active means 'being pressed', a different, non-persistent thing), same idiom as Atom/Button-Toggle; caller sets the standard `aria-pressed` attribute, not a new prop. 'With icon'/'With text' modelled as presence of the `icon`/`children` props; icon-only requires aria-label (type-enforced). Figma's Filled/Selected instance has drifted padding (uniform 8px vs 4px/8px elsewhere) — treated as auto-layout drift, not modelled. Hover fill/stroke use the dedicated surface-hover / border-hover semantic tokens (added 2026-07-20; same stone-300/stone-500 primitives, named for their role). Dark mode (ticket #42): surface-raised/surface-hover/surface/border/border-hover/text/text-muted/priority-urgent-bg now carry a dark override in design/tokens.json → emitted as a `[data-theme="dark"]` block in app/theme.css by `pnpm sync:tokens` (that attribute is what @ladle/react's Light/Dark toggle sets on <html>). No Figma dark-mode frames exist for this node, so the dark shades (stone-700/800/900/400, red-950 — all newly added stock-Tailwind primitives, no one-off hex) are this fix's own pick, not a Figma-sourced value; component classes needed zero changes (no `dark:` utilities) since they were already semantic-token-only — the bug was entirely in the token pipeline, which previously emitted no dark values and no dark selector at all. FIXED 2026-07-20 (#43): Fixed for ticket #43 (2026-07-20): root class was `justify-center`, but every sampled Button/Default variant is a hug-sized row with no `justifyContent` override (Figma default packed/left) — invisible on hug-sized standalone buttons, but wrong once a caller stretches the button full-width (Atom/Dropdown's option-list slot does exactly that) Changed to `justify-start`; no visual change to any existing Button story. UPDATED for ticket #52 (2026-07-20): Figma reworked every colour role to carry a per-state Default/Hover/Selected variation instead of Default + one ad-hoc hover — re-fetched node confirms the ticket's own state matrix verbatim, no discrepancy. Filled hover bg stone-200->stone-400 (new `surface-raised-hover` token, was wrongly stone-300/`surface-hover`); Filled selected bg -> stone-300 (new `surface-raised-selected`, was previously unchanged from default). White selected bg -> stone-50 (new `surface-selected`, was previously unchanged). Outline hover border -> stone-700 (new `border-hover-strong`; `border-hover` itself stays stone-500, since Atom/Input-field's Hover stroke did NOT move — the two roles that used to share `border-hover` have diverged, open question recorded in docs/design-tokens.md); Outline selected border -> stone-400 (new `border-selected`, was wrongly reverting to plain `border`). Distructive gained real Hover (red-200, new `priority-urgent-bg-hover`) and Selected (red-100, new `priority-urgent-bg-selected`) backgrounds — previously this style had no state override at all; its text stays `priority-urgent` in every state. `surface-hover` (stone-300) loses its only consumer here but is kept, unconsumed, per the ticket (may still be wanted elsewhere). See docs/design-tokens.md for the full table and the state-token naming convention future components should follow. TICKET #56 (2026-07-20, supersedes #52's matrix): Figma added a FOURTH state (Active) and redistributed the values - what #52 recorded as Hover is now Active (pressed), Hover took a milder new value, and Selected no longer changes fill/stroke at all, only the text (-> text/stone-950). Re-fetched node 3623:4346 confirms: Filled stone-200/stone-300/stone-400, White white/stone-50/stone-100, Outline stroke stone-300/stone-400/stone-700, Distructive red-50/red-100/red-200 (Distructive Selected is identical to Default, text stays red-400 throughout). Transparent has NO fill in any state - so a transparent button has no pointer affordance at all; flagged as a design question in docs/design-tokens.md, not invented here. Modelled as `hover:` + `active:` (CSS :active is exactly Figma's new 'being pressed' state) + `aria-pressed:text-text`; the three compose because Selected touches only `color` while Hover/Active touch only background/border - a stated product requirement (a selected button must still react to the pointer), so no aria-pressed:bg-*/border-* override may ever be added. Tokens renamed to the role/-hover/-active scale; the *-selected colour tokens #52 added were removed (Selected has no background of its own). Stories cut from 10 exports to 2 (StateMatrix + args-driven Playground) so Button no longer fills the Ladle sidebar with one heading per state.

Atom/Tag.notes: Figma 'Color' axis → semantic CVA variant: Grey→neutral, Red→urgent, Yellow→medium, Blue→mid, Green→low (matches card priority enum)

Atom/Input-field.notes: Figma 'Trekking-icon' is a misnomer for the TRAILING icon → code prop `trailingIcon`. 'Field'+'Title' → `label` (requires `id`, type-enforced, since an RSC cannot useId); 'Content' → native placeholder/value; 'Button' SLOT → `button` named slot (not a hardcoded Button instance, per CLAUDE.md). NOT MODELLED: Figma's 'Text' bool can hide the whole input row, leaving only the button slot — meaningless for an input atom, flagged for triage. FIXED 2026-07-20 (#44): every padding/gap was already numerically correct against the dev-ready node; the reported 'wrong spacing' was the container's `items-center`, which centers the shorter 32px leading+text column inside the row's real 40px height (set by the trailing icon), adding a phantom ~4px offset absent from Figma's implicit top alignment - corrected to `items-start`. UPDATED 2026-07-20 (#53): re-fetched node shows the semantic variables were reworked since #44 and the set now has three real, distinct container strokes: Default stone-300 (content stone-300 placeholder), Hover stone-500 (content stone-300 placeholder), Active stone-400 (content stone-950 typed). The invented 2px focus-within ring from #44 (which reused border-hover because no Focus state existed) is removed; focus is now expressed as `focus-within:border-border-selected` (new stone-400/stone-500(dark) token, design/tokens.json), matching the fetched Active stroke exactly — no ring/outline. FLAGGED HONESTLY, not resolved silently: (a) Figma names this third state 'Active', not 'Focus' — mapping it to `:focus-within` is this atom's reading (it's the only interaction state left in the set and its sample shows a typed value), needs design confirmation; (b) a 1px border-colour change is a weak focus affordance for keyboard users and Figma offers nothing stronger in this node — flagged as a design question, no ring/outline was invented to compensate. Deliberately NOT `accent`: #45 established accent's purple entered the codebase from a Figma canvas artifact (the dashed stroke marking a selected component set), never from design intent - reusing it would have re-introduced the wrong colour in a second component. Story count reduced #44→#53: 10 stories (several stale/duplicate) collapsed to 4 — States, Playground (Ladle arg-driven), WithIconlessButton, WithAndWithoutIcon. TICKET #56 (2026-07-20): re-fetched node 3705:4402 and confirmed it was NOT re-authored along with Atom/Button - still three states (Default stone-300 / Hover stone-500 / Active stone-400), i.e. its Hover stroke is DARKER than its Active one, the reverse of Button/Outline's new ordering (hover stone-400 -> active stone-700). Read as an authoring leftover: this node was never re-bound to the reworked semantic variables. Rather than normalise either component by guessing, this one now reads two PROVISIONAL component-scoped tokens, `border-input-hover` (stone-500) and `border-input-focus` (stone-400), replacing its former use of the shared `border-hover`/`border-selected` (both of which changed meaning in #56). DELETE those two tokens and point this component at the shared `border-hover`/`border-active` scale once Figma is reconciled - tracked as open question 1 in docs/design-tokens.md. TICKET #58 (2026-07-20): re-fetched node 3705:4402 again, expecting the deletion above to now be possible since the node grew a fourth state (Selected), matching Button's shape. It is NOT possible: Default still matches Button's Default (stone-300, so this atom keeps reading the shared `border` token there), but Hover (stone-500) and the new Active value (no existing primitive matched it; added this ticket as `stone-600`, ~#57534D) remain pixel-different from Button/Outline's Hover (stone-400) and Active (stone-700) - confirmed by fetching 3623:4346 side by side, not assumed. The #56 ordering bug IS fixed (Hover stone-500 is now correctly lighter than Active stone-600, same direction as Button), which is why this reads as a deliberate, stable, component-specific ramp rather than an unbound leftover - so the two tokens are kept, no longer described as provisional, and `border-input-focus` is renamed `border-input-active` to match the Figma state it actually reads (the `:focus-within` mapping is still this atom's own interpretation of that state, unchanged from #53/#56 - see below). Also flagged, not resolved: the fetched node's new Selected state changes both its border (stone-400) and its sample content text (stone-950, a 'typed' look) - the 'typed' tell that #53 used to justify reading Active as focus has now moved onto Selected; Active's own content text is plain placeholder-grey, same as Default/Hover. REVIEW CORRECTION (orchestrator, same ticket): the agent's first pass kept `:focus-within` on Active and left Selected unmodelled, which is inconsistent with the state semantics Button just established and left the field never showing its Selected border. All four states are now modelled the same way Button maps them: Hover -> `:hover`, Active -> `:active` (Figma's Active = being pressed, exactly CSS :active), Selected -> `:focus-within` (it is the state whose sample shows typed rather than placeholder content, i.e. the field has been engaged - and that typed tell is precisely what justified the focus reading in #53, it merely moved from Active onto Selected in this re-fetch). `border-input-selected` (stone-400) was added for it. Still an interpretation - Figma labels states, not CSS hooks - so it stays flagged for design confirmation. ALSO OPEN: the user's stated intent was for this component to use the SAME COLOURS as Button. It now has the same four state names, but every value except Default sits one stop lighter than Button's (Hover stone-500 vs stone-400, Active stone-600 vs stone-700, Selected stone-400 vs Button's no-change). Either deliberate (input borders being a distinct role) or the variables were bound one step off - needs the user, and until then the two ramps stay separate rather than being silently normalised. Story count cut #53(4)->#58(5) per the ticket's explicit list: States, WithLeadingIcon, WithTrailingIcon, WithBothIcons, WithoutIcons - Playground, WithIconlessButton and WithAndWithoutIcon were deleted (button-slot demos are out of scope for this ticket's five-story cap).

Checkbox.notes: Checked=No/Yes prop; fetched node has no 'delete' state — needs triage before a future ticket adds it (#16). Fixed #45 2026-07-20: (1) check-icon colour was `accent`/purple-figma (#8A38F5), a mix-up with the component-SET node's own dashed purple selection-boundary stroke reported by MCP (a Figma canvas artifact, not a design property) — the real glyph colour, sampled from the exported Checked=Yes PNG, is #79716B, an exact match for the existing stone-500-backed `text-muted` token, so it was reused as-is with no tokens.json/theme.css change; Figma's own role name for this (`color/stroke/secondary`) has no dedicated semantic entry yet — flagged here as the gap for a future real token-sync pass, not papered over. (2) host element changed from `<div role="checkbox">` to a native `<button type="button" role="checkbox">` (same technique as `Button/Toggle`) so Space/Enter + focus work for free from the browser; `checked` stays fully composer-owned (drives `aria-checked` directly), composer supplies its own `onClick` — atom remains a Server Component, no internal state.

Icon/*.notes: single wrapper around lucide-react@1.25.0+ (upgraded 2026-07-20 for the Broccoli icon, added upstream between v1.14–1.15). Figma layer names are kept in sync with lucide export names (renamed 2026-07-20, refined same day: Clock→Alarm-clock-check, Cake→Cake-slice, List→Scroll, Folder→Folder-closed, Columns→Columns-3, Cross→X, Calandar typo fixed to Calendar) so IconName is a direct PascalCase lookup — every entry verified against rendered SVG structure, not name alone (caught 3 real bugs this way: Columns was previously mismapped to Columns2 — a 2-column/1-divider icon — when Figma's vector has 2 dividers = 3 columns; Cross was mapped by literal name to lucide's medical-cross glyph instead of X; the sidebar-panel icons (nodes 3629:126 / 3687:4453) went through an open/close label swap then a left/right correction — the app's sidebar sits on the left, so they're now 'Panel-left-close'/'Panel-left-open', matching the verified divider-at-x=9 geometry — both fixed 2026-07-20 by the user). No open discrepancies remain.

Dropdown.notes: Built #34. Single COMPONENT (no State/variant axis, unlike Input-field's component set). 'Field'+'Title' → `label` (requires `id`, type-enforced, same idiom as InputField); SLOT 'Slot' (always present, not gated by a bool) → required `children`. `Step`/`Leading-icon`/`Trekking-icon` were dangling propertyDefinitions (unbound to any layer) flagged at build time and removed from the Figma component 2026-07-20 after triage — code already matched, nothing to update. Colours reuse existing tokens with no gap: white→surface, stone-300→border, stone-500→text-muted. UPDATED for ticket #43 (2026-07-20): (1) option-content centring was actually a Button.tsx bug, fixed there (see Atom/Button note), not in this file. (2) Added real open/close disclosure behaviour — this atom is now a Client Component (`"use client"`) that owns its own `isOpen` state, a deliberate exception to the Server-Component default (justified in the component's own doc comment): the disclosure behaviour is intrinsic and identical for every caller, unlike InputField's caller-varying `button` slot, which stayed a Server Component. When `label` is present it is now a real `<button>` trigger with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, replacing the old `role="group"` + `aria-labelledby` panel (dropped per the ticket: no ARIA role is needed on a disclosure's content region once the trigger carries aria-expanded/aria-controls). Enter/Space work for free (native `<button>`); Escape closes and refocuses the trigger. Animation is the CSS-grid `0fr`/`1fr` row trick (Tailwind utility classes only), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion` via `motion-reduce:transition-none`. FLAGGED GAPS (not built, by design): no chevron/indicator icon was added — the fetched node samples no such affordance and one isn't invented; a labelless Dropdown (no `label` prop) has no header to turn into a trigger, so it keeps the old static always-open `role="group"` behaviour unchanged — a labelless real disclosure would need a Figma-side header/trigger added to the node (or a future dedicated trigger slot) before it can be built.

Button/Toggle.notes: Built #35 2026-07-20. No State/Active variant axis in the fetched node — propertyDefinitions are only Text (default 'Categorie ', trailing space is a Figma authoring artifact, dropped), With text, With icon; the pressed look in the fetched demo is a plain rectangle (white, rounded 6, inset 4px) layered behind one nested Atom/Button instance, not a component property — implemented as aria-pressed + CSS pseudo-class (group-aria-pressed:), confirming the ticket's default assumption over a props-driven variant. Fetched node's actual content is a fixed demo of 5 icon-only Atom/Button instances (Infinity/Croissant/Sandwich/Broccoli/Cake-slice) sharing one grey track (root fill stone-200/surface-raised) with one pressed — that grouped-track composition is NOT modelled by this atom (out of scope for #35; flagged for a future toggle-group molecule/organism ticket). This atom instead models one segment: outer root always bg-surface-raised (rounded-lg, 4px padding all sides, 40px tall, matches the fetched root exactly), inner span is the highlight capsule (32x32, rounded-md) that fills bg-surface only when aria-pressed. Icon/text colour does not change between pressed/unpressed in the fetched node (unlike Atom/Button's Filled→Active), so no text-colour pseudo-class was added, only background. No Hover instance is sampled for Button/Toggle itself — none invented; flag before adding one. The nested Atom/Button instance's own override padding ('0 12' inside a fixed 32px width) doesn't reconcile with a 24px icon — treated as the same kind of auto-layout drift Atom/Button already documents for its Filled/Active instance; icon/text spacing instead reuses Atom/Button's verified recipe (icon-only 8/8, text-only 12/12, both 8 left/12 right). Figma exposes no icon-swap property at the Button/Toggle level (only Text/With text/With icon) — `icon` is added as a normal optional prop (mirrors Atom/Button's `icon`) so the atom is usable beyond the one hardcoded demo icon. Figma's Text default is user-facing but is NOT hardcoded in the component (children is always caller-supplied, matching Atom/Button's own no-baked-default precedent) — reproduced only in messages/en.json + messages/nl.json (`components.buttonToggle.defaultLabel`) and the Ladle story, so a translated default never has to be fetched with a server-only i18n call inside a leaf atom that a Client Component composer needs to import directly for onClick/aria-pressed wiring.

Card.notes: Props Title (bool)+Text (text) -> `title?: string`; Step (bool) -> `step?: ReactNode` composed via the existing Step molecule instance (Figma nests a real Step instance here); SLOT 'Type' -> required `children`. No variant/state axis on the node (booleans + text only) so no CVA — clsx merges className, same as Step. No token gaps: heading #0C0A09->text, slot fill #FFFFFF->surface, slot stroke #D6D3D1->border, all existing tokens. The 'Stap + Card' frame's own 12px corner radius has no fill/stroke so it's a no-op and is not modelled.

Step.notes: 32x32 circular badge (radius 99px → rounded-full), bg stone-200 (surface-raised), text-sm/semibold stone-500 (text-muted). Figma files it under the Atoms 'Steps' frame, but this map is canonical (ADR-0010) so it lives in molecules/. Fetched node is a single COMPONENT with no variant/state axis — no CVA added, content via children.
